name: Fertility & IVF clinics (category guide)
summary: Public AR co-funding needs a Singapore Citizen spouse — EP–EP couples budget private cash cycles, MediSave myths, and waiting-list realism at KKH/NUH/SGH.
body: MOH Assisted Conception Procedure co-funding at public AR centres (KKH, NUH, SGH) requires that you or your spouse is a Singapore Citizen at cycle start — two EP holders generally pay full private or public-as-private rates. Citizen–foreigner couples get a lower co-funding band than SC–SC pairs; read the current Made-For-Families / MOH tables before you assume 75%. MediSave ART withdrawal rules are citizenship- and account-gated — most EP-only households cannot treat MediSave as the funding plan. Private fertility clinics trade queue time for cash; public centres may wait months for workup. Ask what is included in a ‘cycle’ quote (meds, ICSI, freezing, storage) and how overseas gamete/embryo shipping is handled. Pair clinic shopping with maternity insurance waiting periods and newborn-pass clocks — fertility success starts a different admin rail. This is a category guide, not a ranked embryologist list.
